messages:
Maya L.: Mini async — quick status check

Maya L.: What I did: converted synthia-v2 to tinyq (4-bit), ran the smoke eval harness against prompt-set-v3 (500 samples).

Maya L.: Blockers: seeing a quality regression on the 'long-instruction' subset (~7% drop in exact-match) and occasional KV-cache mismatch errors when sequence > 2k tokens. Logs show KV read/write misalign around step 12.

Maya L.: Today: going to reproduce with the local runtime, add an assert in the KV flush path, and open a PR for conservative fallback to kv-shadow for longctx.

Oliver: :eyes: can you paste the failing example (prompt + outputs)?

Maya L.: Yep — sample below. Expected concise instruction-following, got truncated and repeated tokens.

Maya L.:
```
PROMPT:
Translate to Spanish: "Please summarize the following article about energy grids..." (long ~2200 tokens context)

EXPECTED:
Resumen breve sobre las implicaciones de la red...

ACTUAL:
Resumen breve sobre las implicaciones de la red...Resumen breve sobre las implicaciones de la red...<garbled>
```

Priya: I saw similar flakiness on the tinyq branch earlier. Might be quantized attention precision slipping on long keys. Did you try running with kv_cache_mode=shadow? If that fixes it we should gate in the rollout.

Maya L.: Not yet, running that next. If shadow fixes, I'll set rollout to canary-1 and mark the rest blocked.

EvalBot: automated-eval: synthia-v2 tinyq smoke run 2026-03-17 09:21 UTC — metric: exact_match 0.78 -> 0.72 (regression detected), p<0.01 :warning:

Chen: pinging eng-runtime infra — @Ryan D. can you help check the kernel selection logs? suspect a different attention kernel got picked for sequence lengths >1024 during the quantized path.

Ryan D.: on it, checking runtime traces now. can you dump /mnt/logs/kv_regen/* from the failing run id? also what's the model fingerprint/hash?

Maya L.: run id: run-20260317-2145, model hash: b1f3e9a. Logs: 
```
E KVCACHE MISMATCH at step 12: expected len 1200 got 1184
stack: runtime/kv_cache.cc:204
```

Priya: also opened a tiny PR to add an assert + fallback in the attention wrapper: https://git.redwood/s/pr/1234 — reviewers: @Priya, @Oliver. It's small, adds shadow-mode toggle and safer memcpy.

Oliver: I'll review this afternoon. If tests pass, let's hold auto-rollout and do canary=1 for 24h.

Maya L.: Thanks. Quick ask: can someone run the prompt-set-v3 subset 'long-instruction' with kv_cache_mode=shadow and post the eval snapshot? I want to compare deltas.

Priya: running now on dedicated 3 — will post results here when done.

EvalBot: quick note — I also flagged 4 samples with hallucination patterns on the same subset; added to regression-hotlist ticket #892.

Maya L.: cool, linking ticket: https://tracker.redwood.com/892

Chen: if shadow fixes it let's add a transient flag to rollout config so Hosted can fallback during high-latency windows.

Ryan D.: found kernel switch at 2026-03-17T09:18:22Z — attaching trace id trace-zz-77 (will dump to #infra-traces). Probably related to kernel selector heuristics.

Maya L.: Summary: reproducing locally, running shadow eval, PR up for review, holding rollout to canary-1. Will follow up with results and attach eval diffs. Thanks all :heart:

Priya: thx — ping me when you have the diff, I'll prep a short changelog entry for the rollout notes.

Oliver: 👍
